Any such disclosure— intentional or otherwise—shall render the concerned bid liable for immediate rej ection for that particular schedule or the entire bidding process, as applicable. This clause is non-negotiable and is aimed at preserving the sanctity and impar tiality of the technical evaluation process. Clause 2: Abnormally Low Quoted Amounts and Disqualification To uphold the principles of fair competition and to prevent any attempt to secur e L1 status through non-bonafide practices, it is hereby stipulated that: If any item within a schedule is quoted at an abnormally low price (e.g., ₹1 or any other value significantly below reasonable market rates), the respec tive evaluation committee shall have the discretion to examine the quotati on for its reasonableness. In such cases, a one-time opportunity for justification shall be provided to t he concerned bidder(s) through the GeM portal. The bidder must furnish a valid and satisfactory explanation or cost breakup justifying the quoted pri ce within the specified timeline. Failure to submit such justification, the inability to provide at that price, or submission of an inadequate/unsatisfactory justification may result in the r ejection of the quoted item(s) and disqualification of the bid for that partic ular schedule or the entire tender, as deemed appropriate by the Compete nt Authority. The decision of the Evaluation Committee/Competent Authority in this rega rd shall be final and binding, and no further correspondence shall be entert ained. Clause 3: Rejection of Bids in Case of Identical IP Address In order to ensure transparency and fairness in the bidding process, it is hereby stipulated that if two or more bids are found to have been submitted from the s ame IP address, such bids shall be treated as non-compliant and shall be summ arily rejected without any further consideration. As per CAG, “Placing of more than one bid for the same tender from the same I P address more often than not shows that the same computer was used to plac e the bids and is an indicator for collusion among bidders.” This provision is aimed at preventing collusive bidding or any attempt to manip ulate the procurement process. The decision of the Competent Authority in this regard shall be final and binding.

Clause 4: Mandatory Submission of Compliance Sheet with Manufactur er Details To ensure authenticity and traceability of the materials, the seller shall provide a schedule-wise compliance sheet on the signed letterhead of the firm a t the time of bid submission.
